up: Retrieve distinct compounds (CHEMBL IDs) and their canonical SMILES for molecules tested in human assays against the target pyruvate kinase PKM (CHEMBL1075189). Filter assays by organism 'Homo sapiens' using the assay_organism column. Return only the CHEMBL ID and canonical SMILES columns. Ensure results are distinct by compound.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM assays a
JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE a.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1075189'
  AND a.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
